1.

The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Ratu P.S. Case No.469 of 2023 registered under Sections 467/468/471/419/420/406/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
It is jointly submitted by learned counsel for the petitioners and the opposite party no.2 that the present dispute between both the parties has amicably been settled at JHALSA, Ranchi.

The terms and conditions of the settlement dated 25th October, 2024 has been appended with the report of the Mediator, JHALSA, Ranchi as contained in letter no.3385A, dated 26th October, 2024.
3.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering that the petitioners and the opposite party no.2 have amicably settled the present dispute in mediation proceeding at JHALSA,
Ranchi as per the terms and conditions of settlement dated 25th October, 2024, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioners on anticipatory bail.
